hooks.command:
# forge: modified from upstream — retained notification while using a stable forge-managed signature.
: 'forge-managed'; command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1 && osascript -e 'display notification "Task completed" with title "Codex — Forge"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# forge: modified from upstream — re-rooted telemetry to the plugin script and target repository state.
: 'forge-managed'; session_id="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; value=json.load(sys.stdin).get("session_id"); sys.exit(2) if not isinstance(value,str) or not value else print(value)' 2>/dev/null)" && bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/forge/aggregate-telemetry.sh" .forge/tmp/decisions --append-csv .forge/tmp/telemetry.csv --session "$session_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
